description: Create it now, on a signed-in connection with Manage (https://mcp.qrvote.org/mcp/organizer); up to 5 a day per connection. This connection can manage it straight away. You get its public link and a one-time claim link (valid 24 hours) for the person to open, which gives them the organizer dashboard; never ask for or share the organizer key. Without signing in, use draft_contest.

inputSchema.description: What to fill the create form with. Same shapes as the API (https://qrvote.org/openapi.json).

categories.description: Contests: separate awards, one vote in each (e.g. Scariest, Funniest)

closesAt.description: When voting ends, ISO 8601 with a time zone offset

entries.description: Contests: the entries; hunts: the checkpoints. A name, or { name, description }.

host.description: Quizzes: run it live on a big screen, one question at a time

kind.description: contest: people vote for entries; survey: questions; quiz: questions with right answers and a leaderboard; hunt: find QR checkpoints

lang.description: The voters' language: its QR codes, big screen and printed signs use it (anyone can still switch). Default: the language the person is using, else en.

mode.description: Contests: one vote in total, or one vote per entry (like/heart each)

questions.description: Surveys and quizzes, as in setQuestions: { type: single|multi|yesno|likert|rating|short|long, prompt, options? (single/multi), max? (rating 5 or 10), required?, answer? (quiz: option index, list of indexes, yesno 1/0, or accepted texts for short) }

name: create_contest
title: Create a contest, survey, quiz or hunt
